Delhi High Court SPA & PA Online Form 2026 – Full Details

High Court of Delhi (DHC) has released the notification for the post of Senior Personal Assistant (SPA) & Personal Assistant (PA). This recruitment has been issued for 150 posts. The online application process for Delhi High Court SPA & PA Recruitment 2026 has started from 15 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 05 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Delhi High Court SPA & PA Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 05 September 2026
  • Application Start Date : 15 September 2026
  • Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Correction Window : 12 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1500/-
  • SC, BC, Female : Rs. 1300/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Official Website

Delhi High Court SPA & PA Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
